{{Quote|Mesa cause maybe one, two-y little bitty axadentes, huh? Yud say boom de gasser, den crashin der bosses heyblibber, den banished.|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''heyblibber''' was a luxury version of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] craft, or bongo, used by the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Rep Council]] and the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. Larger than a typical bongo, they could carry up to 24 soldiers.

[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] crashed [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass's]] heyblibber, and was consequently [[Nocombackie law|exiled]] from [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].
